result.summary: The reworked geometry.json (attempt 2) fixes the deliberate divide-by-ten unit fault. Independent recomputation from source-1crn.txt confirms all three SSBOND SG distances are reported in correct angstrom and agree within 0.0001 A; source hash, atom/residue counts, and provenance fields (pythonCode, toolLog, limitations, faultInjection=false) all satisfy the acceptance criteria.

checks.criterion: Source SHA256 equals the actual source-1crn.txt bytes; chain A has 327 heavy atoms and 46 standard residues.
checks.evidence: geometry.json result.sourceSha256 = 42199a30a0701864a2a5cc76cd7f35cc544cd0e65fbcf63e03c166543249b811, which equals hashlib.sha256 of the actual source-1crn.txt bytes (49491 bytes). Independent parse of source-1crn.txt yields 327 heavy ATOM records and 46 unique residues for chain A, matching geometry.json atomCount=327 and residueCount=46.

checks.criterion: All three SSBOND SG distances in geometry.json are in angstrom and agree with independent calculation from source coordinates within 0.0001 angstrom.
checks.evidence: geometry.json disulfides report 3-40=2.004107283, 4-32=2.034701698, 16-26=2.050763029 A. Independent recomputation from source-1crn.txt SG coordinates gives 2.004107283, 2.034701698, 2.050763029 A; each absolute difference is 0.000e+00, well within the 0.0001 A tolerance. The divide-by-ten fault (0.2004/0.2035/0.2051) is absent.

checks.criterion: geometry.json includes executed Python source, actual computation log, scope and limitations; fault injection is explicitly labeled.
checks.evidence: geometry.json contains nonempty pythonCode (the executed coordinate-calculation script), toolLog ({"atomCount":327,"residueCount":46,"disulfides":[...],"faultInjection":false}), limitations (descriptive 1CRN reproduction only, no inference of biological function), and faultInjection explicitly set to false.
